issue.body:
## Problem

When `sample-kit triage` labels an issue, nothing in the log says which issue it labeled.

## Fix

After the label is applied, print `labeled <number>: <title>` with the issue's number and title.

## Done when

- [ ] Each labeled issue prints one `labeled <number>: <title>` line.

pr.title: feat(sample-kit): log each issue triage labels
pr.body: Prints the issue number and title after triage applies a label.
